description.notes: Catch-all single content field for a simple, single-purpose piece (jewelry, footwear, cape, weapon, effect, background).

pose.notes: Limb/hand positioning detail. Also used as the SLOT name for the whole motion bundle on scene cards -- deliberately marked non-overridable so that slot/field name collision can never silently hijack it.

gaze.notes: Where the eyes look. Independently overridable via components.gaze -- a file reference or literal inline text.

expression.notes: Facial/emotional read. Independently overridable via components.expression -- a file reference or literal inline text.

defaultGaze.notes: Motion-internal: the gaze a motion implies by default (canonical alias: gaze). Folded into the pose join unless the card declares its own components.gaze, which replaces it in place.

defaultExpression.notes: Motion-internal: the expression a motion implies by default (canonical alias: expression). Folded into the pose join unless the card declares its own components.expression, which replaces it in place.

mood.notes: Short tonal tag. Currently excluded from generated output (treated as metadata, not content) -- see _COMPONENT_META_KEYS in gen_prompt.py.

extras.notes: Freeform additive list -- general tags that don't claim a reserved field name. Always additive, never participates in the override mechanism.

negatives.notes: List of terms banned while this piece is in use. Emitted as a separate {{<SLOT>_NEG}} token (e.g. realm -> REALM_NEG), never merged into the slot's own text.
